en.headline: Fire Services rolls out new breathing sets with 10-second cylinder change
en.dek: The department said new quick couplings, a shared-air rescue link and mask radios are being issued force-wide this year.
body: The Fire Services Department said it is replacing frontline breathing apparatus across the force this year with a new generation of sets that use a quick coupling, allowing a cylinder to be changed in under 10 seconds instead of about a minute and a half.

Assistant Divisional Officer Yip Chi-ho told the government news service that firefighters previously had to twist a threaded connector to swap cylinders. The new fitting locks with alignment and a press. An emergency breathing safety system also lets two firefighters share air through an interconnecting hose if one supply fails inside a fire.

The new sets integrate a mask communications unit and a team radio with a microphone and earpiece that the department said filters background noise and does not require a press-to-talk button, leaving both hands free. Non-woven harness materials are intended to pick up fewer contaminants and to be easier to clean.

Training grounds at Wong Tai Sin and Pok Fu Lam fire stations have added movable partition systems on ceiling tracks so rooms can be reconfigured to resemble flats, industrial buildings, mini-storages or subdivided units. The Government Information Services posted the briefing on Sunday.

zh.headline: 消防全面換新呼吸器 換氣樽可在10秒內完成
zh.dek: 消防處今年全面更換新一代呼吸器，引入快速接頭、互連供氣及面罩通話裝置，並在訓練場加設活動間隔。
body: 消防處表示，今年全面更換前線人員使用的新一代呼吸器。新裝置採用快速接頭，更換氣樽可由以往約一分半鐘縮短至不足10秒。
助理消防區長葉志豪接受政府新聞網訪問時說，過往更換氣樽要像扭螺絲般轉動接頭；新接頭對準後輕按即可上鎖。新增的緊急呼吸安全系統，可讓兩名隊員以氣喉互連，共享氣樽內的空氣，以便在火場內互相救助。
新款呼吸器整合面罩式通話裝置及小隊通話器，設有麥克風與耳機，部門指可過濾背景雜音，而且無需按鍵，雙手可保持自由。背帶等配件改用非紡織物料，以減少吸附火場污染物，清潔亦較方便。
黃大仙及薄扶林消防局的訓練場已引入活動式間隔系統，利用天花軌道重組空間，模擬住宅、工廈、迷你倉或分間單位等場景。政府新聞處周日發布有關簡介。
